title: a change in a component reached through a DAG of nested $refs is reported once per component declaration
before: GET /reports 200 -> S0 -> {left,right} -> S1 -> ... -> S4 { code: string }
rationale: the usage sites inside the response (left.left...code, one per payload location) are distinct locations a client reads, but under `components` the change belongs to the declaration S4 only; re-expanding it inside S0..S3 once per reference path is exponential (2^(n+1) - 1 component diffs for depth n) and is what inflates real documents (TBAPI order-management: 20 762 diffs for 362 structural differences)
annotation: type change of `code` (with its payload path at usage sites; in schema component `S4` at the declaration)

title: a vendor extension change inside a shared schema
before: S4 { x-owner: team-a } reached through the same DAG
rationale: an `x-*` value is not part of the payload contract; reported once per usage site and `unclassified` it was 11 294 of 20 762 diffs on tbapi-order-management; POLICY-06 (d): annotation; POLICY-57 (decided after P3): an annotation-only change inside a component is reported at its declaration only, not at every usage site (non-annotation changes keep their per-usage diffs, X-VOL-001)
annotation: names the extension key and the schema / payload location

title: an output field removed from one type of a cyclic type graph
before: Query.root: T0; ring T0..T7, each type with 2 fields to the next types and `extra: Int`
rationale: one declaration changed; GraphApi 0.1.2 inlines object types at every usage, so the change is re-reported inside every type on every acyclic path to T7 (hundreds of diffs for 8 types, growing exponentially; the GitHub schema does not finish), while the 1.0 encoding reports it once
annotation: names the type and the field (T7, extra)

sources.ref: docs/BENCHMARK.md §4.5 / §7.2 GraphApi 0.1.2 does not scale (gql-github timeout, > 15 min, 3 GB)

title: inline property schema refactored into allOf [$ref, { deprecated, x-* }] with an equivalent target
after: items.value: { allOf: [ { $ref: Money } , { deprecated: true, x-policy: soft } ] }, Money = { type: number, description }
rationale: the merged allOf is the same schema plus a deprecation, so the only contract change is the deprecation (the 4 consensus breaking operations 2.0.0 missed on the TBAPI release series are this pattern; oasdiff without --flatten-allof and openapi-changes over-report it)
annotation: deprecation of `items[].value` (and the extension as an annotation)

sources.ref: bench/results/tbapi-spotcheck.json category 'inline schema refactored into allOf' (two consecutive release pairs)
